meta.title: 폴드원 E1
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (폴드원 E1, a folding e-bike (fictional)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: A blueprint, as the brief says: deep blue #0F3A78 to #0A2C5E with a minor (24 px) and a major (120 px) grid, white #EAF2FF line work, sky #8FD8FF for every annotation (dimensions, callouts, notes), and one yellow #FFD45E for the hinge and the payoff.
rationale.type: IBM Plex Sans KR for names and lines (700 for the name), Nanum Gothic Coding for every number, as a drawing office would set dimensions.
rationale.motion: Drawn, not animated: every line draws itself along its length; the sheet starts at an angle and turns flat; dimensions grow from their middle to the arrowheads; callouts dot, elbow and label; then the bike folds as a real one does (the front half round the hinge, the stem down, the seat post down) while a counter runs to 3.0.
rationale.sound: Cinematic-lite at 112 BPM in D minor (7 bars in 15 s, 14 in 30 s): strings and a low pulse, sparse; minimal SFX: drawon for the line work, a tick for each dimension, a lock for the hinge.
rationale.visuals: All code: the sheet, the grid, the frame and the title block, the bike in two halves of strokes with a hinge, dimensions with arrowheads and extension lines, leader callouts, a counter.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a muted-first product reveal; the numbers are on the drawing.
